# simplemdm_log (Data Source)

Retrieves a specific SimpleMDM log entry by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "simplemdm_log" "specific" {
  id = "964595dfd5be464a82cbb9019f55d82b"
}

output "log_message" {
  value = data.simplemdm_log.specific.message
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Required. The ID of the log entry to retrieve.

### Read-Only

- `at` (String) The timestamp when the log entry was created.
- `event_type` (String) The event type of the log entry (e.g. 'user.signed_in', 'script.ran').
- `level` (String) The severity level of the log entry.
- `message` (String) The log message body.
- `metadata` (String) Raw JSON metadata associated with the log entry.
- `namespace` (String) The namespace of the log entry (e.g. 'admin', 'device').
- `source` (String) The source of the log entry.
